# Calibro

> Calibro is a bespoke furniture and contract FF&E partner based in Dubai, UAE.

Calibro works with architects, interior designers, developers, and private clients across the UAE and wider GCC. The company creates custom-made furniture and sources, validates, delivers, and installs furniture, joinery, lighting, and rugs through one accountable team.

- Home and company information: https://calibro.ae/
- Selected projects: https://calibro.ae/projects
- Product collection (coming soon): https://calibro.ae/products
- Contact: https://calibro.ae/#contact
